'''Carlos Font Puig'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Font|Puig}} (born 27 January 1960) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed at the [[1976 Winter Olympics]] and the [[1980 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/fo/carlos-font-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417191535/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/fo/carlos-font-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 April 2020 |title=Carlos Font |accessdate=17 March 2018 |quote=Full name: Carlos Font Puig}}</ref> He is the brother of alpine skier [[Miguel Font]].<ref name="SportsRef" />
